@@ -243,6 +243,18 @@ const t = (s) => s;

Escaping

{t("{{x}}")} HTML-escapes; the triple-stash {t("{{{x}}}")} emits raw markup — unchanged from FullBars.

+ +

Inline partials & {t("{{yield}}")}

+

+ Inline partials work in MaxBars: {t("{{#inline \"x\"}}…{{/inline}}")} defines a + partial (hoisted before the render), and {t("{{#partial \"x\"}}body{{/partial}}")} + invokes it with the block body — which the definition drops in at {t("{{yield}}")}, + MaxBars' bare spelling of Handlebars' {t("{{> @partial-block}}")}. The + {t("{{#*inline}}")} decorator and host-threaded external partial + files are the parts that stay a FullBars job (see + where it diverges). +
